# Skyland Suite

> Zero-install, browser-native tools from Skyland Reach — Tech Division. Open in the browser or add to the home screen. No store listing. No device bloat.

Site: https://www.skylandapps.com
Support: support@skylandapps.com

## The suite

- [FRIDAY Canvas](https://www.skylandapps.com/friday-canvas): Private workspace for thoughts, projects, and workload. App: https://www.fridaycanvas.com/
- [FRIDAY Desk](https://www.skylandapps.com/desk): Business tier of FRIDAY Canvas for leaders and growing teams.
- [LnkLokr](https://www.skylandapps.com/lnklokr): On-device vault for links, images, and text. App: https://lnklokr.com/
- [My Support Agent](https://www.skylandapps.com/my-support-agent-2): Suggested reply wording and how to resolve each message. App: https://www.my-support-agent.com/
- [LOKR](https://www.skylandapps.com/my-lokr): Your own encrypted information locker for private messages and files. App: https://my-lokr.com
- [TOC](https://www.skylandapps.com/my-toc): Tactical Operations Command for COOs and chiefs of staff. App: https://mytoc.app
- [My$](https://www.skylandapps.com/mny): What you can spend right now, after bills and before payday. App: https://my-mny.com/
- [MNY$](https://www.skylandapps.com/mnybusiness): Business cash-flow console across accounts, budgets, credit lines, and payroll.
- [Go Shop!](https://www.skylandapps.com/go-shop): Shopping companion for lists, recipes, trips, stock, and budget. App: https://www.my-go-shop.com/
- [Go News](https://www.skylandapps.com/go-news-app): Light news companion across world, faith, geopolitics, sports, and tech. App: https://go-news.app/
- [ChkChk](https://www.skylandapps.com/chkchk): Work-order tracker — assign, track, confirm. App: https://www.chkchk.app/
- [My Secret Agent](https://www.skylandapps.com/my-secret-agent): Watches prices, stocks, weather, and websites, then notifies you.
- [GIA](https://www.skylandapps.com/gia): Go Intelligence Agency — operatives on markets, competitors, and signals.
